## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** op=use builds lcs_<slug> on the control plane and launches it on the session's node; no in-session file swap proven

**Pick whip: partial.** characters op=use with session_id reads the player's outfit from live RAM (identify: FindPlayerPed -> model index -> hash), then builds every outfit; no screen-point mapping, other peds only via cast slots; generic pick_identify = slot guess

**Live controls:** gta_mods car_jump and ped_rain only (logic proven in a MIPS emulator on a RAM snapshot, never in pcsx2); gta_live player, pools, teleport (no vehicle stride, no spawn).
